questions.explanation: Accuracy: Choose a metric that matches the task, compute it on the intended split, and inspect representative errors before interpreting one aggregate score.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Precision and recall”, what should a learner verify?
options: Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
verify class/target shapes, threshold choices, split independence, and that model selection did not repeatedly use test results.
questions.answer_key: verify class/target shapes, threshold choices, split independence, and that model selection did not repeatedly use test results.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: verify class/target shapes, threshold choices, split independence, and that model selection did not repeatedly use test results.
